realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Architect
primary.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
primary.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
primary.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

secondary.label: Diplomat
secondary.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
secondary.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
secondary.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.central_question: Should we build a home, or discover a new one?

growth.label: Diplomat
growth.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
growth.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
growth.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

other_ally.label: Chancellor
other_ally.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
other_ally.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

quarter.label: Reformer
quarter.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
quarter.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

opposite.label: Explorer
opposite.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
opposite.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
